title: Universal Engineering Lab Coordinator — Overview and definition
t: Universal Engineering Lab Coordinator — Overview and definition
description: Routes work across design, simulation, instruments, and documentation in one workflow.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Routes work across design, simulation, instruments, and documentation in one workflow. A universal engineering lab coordinator connects CAD, solvers, instruments, test frameworks, and document generators into one traceable workflow with a shared project model. It dispatches jobs, collects artifacts, enforces review gates, and keeps a complete provenance chain from requirement to report. Real implementations are built on workflow orchestrators (Airflow, Temporal) with engineering adapters.
capabilities: Unified project model linking requirements, designs, tests, and reports
Job dispatch to solvers, instruments, and build agents
Review gates with sign-off and audit trails
Artifact collection with content-hash provenance
Dashboard of every project's verification state

Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Unified project model linking requirements, designs, tests, and reports). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output.
